correctness.rationale: With two deleted positions in source runs separated by at least two complete intermediary runs, compare the two deletion-count trajectories; intervals with discrepancy one force identical adjacent symbols. Hence any alternative deletions must occur within the same two original runs, so multiplicity is product of their lengths. The probability of two uniformly chosen positions lying within two run indices is O_q(1/n); two two-sided iid neighborhoods couple to independent Palm size-biased geometric run lengths with O_q(1/n) exception. This proves total-variation O_q(1/n); exponential geometric tails uniformly control log multiplicity, making E log Z_n=2 E log L+o(1). Exact channel identity H(Y|X)=log binom(n,2)-E log Z_n completes the nats mutual-information formula. Independent exhaustive small q-ary runs and deletion shadows corroborate the rigidity condition; no finite enumeration proves the asymptotic.
